title: Moon Tide
meta_description: Welcome to Moon Tide, a magnificent Seacrest cottage that strikes a beautiful balance between peaceful suburban living and laidback beachy elegance. With an oversized swimming pool, 3 private bedrooms, easy beach access, and 4 beach cruiser bikes.
description_expanded: DescriptionYOUR PRIVATE COASTAL RETREAT ON 30AMoon Tide is a beautifully appointed 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom Seacrest Beach cottage that sleeps 6 and was designed to make every moment of your stay extraordinary. Featuring a vibrant vintage-inspired interior, an oversized screened-in private pool, and four complimentary beach cruiser bikes, this home delivers the perfect blend of relaxed coastal living and true luxury.Gather, Cook & Unwind in StyleThe moment you step inside, you'll be struck by the vibrant mosaic tile that flows throughout the entire home — warm, cheerful, and completely unlike any rental you've stayed in before. The open kitchen is a true entertainer's dream, outfitted with marble countertops and backsplash, sleek white and matte black cabinetry, a wine fridge, in-drawer microwave, dishwasher, and a full electric range. A generous dining area with an upholstered bench keeps everyone together at the table. The spacious living room features a plush sectional sofa, large HDTV, and bright windows overlooking the pool — plus a sliding glass door leading directly out to your private backyard.Three Comfortable BedroomsPrimary Suite — Queen bed with elegant wicker headboard; ensuite bathroom with subway tile shower and marble vanity; stacked washer and dryer just outside the doorGuest Bedroom — Queen bed; shared full bathroom with step-in showerBunk Bedroom — Twin-over-twin bunk bed; perfect for kids or extra guestsA Backyard Built for VacationStep outside into a full resort-style retreat: an oversized screened-in private pool (heat available for $45/day + tax), a covered terrace with propane grill and outdoor dining, a fire pit perfect for evening cocktails, a full bocce ball court, and an outdoor shower to rinse off after the beach.Easy Beach AccessMoon Tide is located in the charming Seacrest Beach community, just a short ride from 30A's award-winning sugar-white sand beaches and emerald Gulf waters. Four complimentary beach cruiser bikes are included so you can pedal straight to the shoreline. Local restaurants, boutique shopping, and Camp Creek Golf Club are all close by.WHAT'S INCLUDED AT A GLANCE3 Bedrooms | 2 Bathrooms | Sleeps 6Primary Bedroom: queen bed | ensuite bathroom with showerGuest Bedroom: queen bed | shared full bathroomGuest Bedroom: twin-over-twin bunk bedOutdoors:Private screened pool (heatable) | Covered terrace | Propane grill | Fire pit | Bocce ball court | Outdoor shower | 4 beach cruiser bikes | Fenced backyardKitchen & Living:Wine fridge | Marble counters | Dishwasher | In-drawer microwave | Full range | HDTV + sectional | High-speed WiFi |Extras:Washer & dryer in unit | Beach towels provided | ParkingLocationSeacrest Beach, Scenic Highway 30A | Close to beach, restaurants, shops & Camp Creek Golf ClubTDT-040414
